svg.title: Диаграмма классов: сервисный слой, модули и интеграции

g.text: Диаграмма классов: сервисный слой, модули и интеграции
AttendanceCalculator — чистые функции без БД (тестируются без Django, ЛР6).
Время передаётся в сервисы через IClock, в правила — параметром now (подмена в тестах).
+screen(chat_id: str, action: str, number: int): tuple
+mutate(chat_id: str, action: str, object_id: int, text: str, attachment): tuple
-_store_calendar(group: Group, content: bytes, semester: str, semester_start: date, source: str): None
+import_ics(file: BinaryIO, group_id: int, semester: str): ImportResult
+build_calendar(payload: dict, group_name: str, source: str): ScheduleCalendar
+build_services(clock: IClock = None, channel: INotificationChannel = None): Services
+allowed_misses(total: int, missed: int, threshold_percent: int): int
+calculate(lessons: list[Lesson], records: list[AttendanceRecord], threshold_percent: int, now: datetime): AttendanceStats
+can_mark(user: Student, lesson: Lesson, now: datetime): bool
+can_edit(user: Student, record: AttendanceRecord, now: datetime): bool
+can_assign_delegate(grantor: Student, delegate: Student, now: datetime): bool
+save_marks(user: Student, lesson_id: int, marks: dict[int, AttendanceStatus], reason: str, expected_version: int, reasons: dict[int, str] = None): None
+correct_record(actor: Student | Teacher, record_id: int, new_status: AttendanceStatus, reason: str, source: ChangeSource): None
+lessons_for_student(user: Student, from_: datetime, to: datetime): list[LessonSummary]
+set_absence_reason(student: Student, record_id: int, text: str, attachment = None): None
+create(student: Student, record_id: int, comment: str, attachment = None): Dispute
+resolve(resolver: Teacher, dispute_id: int, fix: bool, comment: str): None
+set_threshold(teacher: Teacher, course_id: int, percent: int): None
+for_student(student: Student, from_: datetime, to: datetime): list[StudentCourseReport]
+get_student_history(teacher: Teacher, course: Course, student_id: int, from_: datetime, to: datetime): list[AttendanceChange]
+for_course(teacher: Teacher, course: Course, from_: datetime, to: datetime): CourseReport
+notify(recipient: Student, type: NotificationType, text: str): None
+notify_headmen(group_id: int, type: NotificationType, text: str): None
